_about: Numbers behind the README charts. Measured, not estimated; see notes per block. Regenerate charts with: python3 docs/charts/make_charts.py

accuracy.metric: mean Jaccard of the detected page vs. the labelled page after undoing perspective (higher is better)
sets: SmartDoc 2015 bg04: white paper on a white desk
SmartDoc 2015 bg05: cluttered desk, stacked sheets, cable across the page
accuracy.notes: classic_opencv = contour pipeline (gray, blur, Canny, dilate/erode, biggest 4-point contour), all frames of the unseen backgrounds. salinlens = shipped model C0 + 0.25*HN + 0.5*MIDV, every 10th frame of the same videos (dev set; weights were blended using this set, so it is slightly optimistic).

heldout.metric: hull IoU, 8 photos labelled before any model ran, scored once (test2)

apk.note: arm64-v8a release APK, compressed sizes inside the zip, model included
parts_mb: Native libraries (ONNX Runtime, Lynx engine, text and graphics)

latency.note: onnxruntime 1.32 CPU on an Apple-silicon Mac, 300 runs after 20 warm-up, input 1x3x192x320 float32. A desktop proxy: phones are slower. Not yet measured on a phone.
